articles.description: Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor discuss the IDF officers' testimony in their film 'NAZA' and why they didn't shy away from drawing parallels to World War II. Of the backlash that awaits them in Israel, Abraham says: 'I don't want to be an exile'
articles.content: NEW YORK Filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor haven't been back to Israel since "NAZA," their documentary about the Israeli military's conduct in Gaza, premiered in Venice earlier this month.
